title: 终南山·银杏秋色
prompt: Create one beautiful fine-art watercolor landscape of an ancient ginkgo tree in autumn at the foot of Zhongnan Mountain, China. Portrait 4:5 composition. A magnificent old ginkgo is the unmistakable main subject, its thick deeply textured trunk and sweeping branches supporting a luminous, expansive golden-yellow canopy. Clearly recognizable delicate fan-shaped ginkgo leaves, some drifting gently in the air, and a rich carpet of golden fallen leaves across the foreground. A modest traditional Chinese temple courtyard with restrained gray-tiled eaves and weathered walls partly glimpsed behind the tree; softly receding blue-gray wooded mountain ridges and pale morning mist in the distance. A quiet stone path leads toward the tree. Warm slanting autumn sunlight filters through leaves, balanced with cool atmospheric mountain shadows. Refined vintage watercolor travel-illustration aesthetic, fine restrained ink drawing, transparent layered pigment, delicate granulation, warm ivory watercolor paper with subtle fibers, poetic spatial depth and exquisite botanical detail. One coherent immersive scenic painting, not a multi-panel collage. Let the giant golden crown dominate, with ample breathing room and full readable tree silhouette; subtle feathered watercolor margins. No people, no text, no lettering, no logos, no seals, no watermark, no unrelated landmarks, no modern objects, no 3D miniature base. An artistic evocation of Zhongnan autumn, not a documentary reconstruction of a specific temple.
